content: Fii no Iisaa Almasiihu on Ɓurdi Malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen
Nde wonnoo Alla yewtiriino maamiraaɓe men ɓen annabaaɓe ɓen laawi buy e nooneeji buy,
Alla yewtirii en ka ɲalaaɗe sakkitore ɗoo Ɓiɗɗo on. O waɗi mo ronoowo e kala huunde, awa ko on o tagiri aduna on.

Ko on Ɓiɗɗo woni jalbeendi annoora Alla on, ko kanko woni mbaadi Alla ndin tigi. Ko on Ɓiɗɗo woni tambitiiɗo kala huunde rewrude e daaluyee makko dolnuɗo on. Nde o laatinnoo laɓɓingol yimɓe ɓen junuubaaji maɓɓe ɗin, o jooɗoyii ka sengo ɲaamo Alla Mawɗo on ka kammuuli,
o woni ɓurɗo malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen, wano innde nde o roni nden ɓurdiri ɗe maɓɓe ɗen non.
Ko fii ko hombo e malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen Alla daalani:

content.text: «Ko an woni Ɓiɗɗo an on, hande a wonii mo an»,
«Mi wonanay mo Baaba,
o wonanammi Ɓiɗɗo.»?

content: Ɓay o addii Afo on ka nder aduna, o daali kadi:

content.text: «Yo malaa'ikaaɓe Alla ɓen fow sujjan mo.»
«O waɗay malaa'ikaaɓe makko ɓen hendu
e kurkaaɗi makko ɗin ɗenɗe yiite.»

content: Kono fii Ɓiɗɗo on o daali:

content.text: «Jullere maa laamu nden, yaa an Alla, luttay haa poomaa,
labbooru maa laamu ndun ko labbooru peewal.
A yiɗii peewal ngal, a aɲii angal peewal ngal.
Ko ɗun waɗi si Alla Joomiraaɗo maa on
toɗɗor maa nebban weltaare ɓuri wondiɓɓe maa ɓen.»

content: E hoore ɗun o daali kadi:

content.text: «Yaa an Joomiraaɗo, ko an wallini ndelo leydi ndin ka fuɗɗoode,
awa kadi kammuuli ɗin ko juuɗe maa ɗen tagiraa.

content: Ɗi lannay, kono an a luttay,

content.text: ɗi fow ɗi nawyiray wa dolokke,
ɲobbiraa ɗi wa waanaare,
e hoore ɗun ɗi waylirte wa dolokke.
Kono an a wa'ay no wa'uɗaa,
awa kadi, duuɓi maa ɗin lannataa.»

content: E ko hombo e malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen o daalani:

content.text: «Jooɗor ka sengo an ɲaamo,
haa mi waɗa ayɓe maa ɓen ka ley teppe maa.»?

content: Hara ɓee malaa'ikaaɓe fow, hinaa ɓe ruuhuuji kurkotooɗi, nulaaɗi fii gollangol ronooɓe kisiyee ɓen?
